items.headline: Rip Current Statement issued October 3 at 3:34AM EDT until October 4 at 4:00AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents.

* WHERE...Walton and Bay County Beaches.

* WHEN...Through late Saturday night.

* IMPACTS...Rip currents can sweep even the best swimmers away
from shore into deeper water.
items.instruction:
Swim near a lifeguard. If caught in a rip current, relax and
float. Don't swim against the current. If able, swim in a
direction following the shoreline. If unable to escape, face the
shore and call or wave for help.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 3 at 12:52AM EDT until October 5 at 8:00AM EDT by NWS Tallahassee FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is possible.

* WHERE...Portions of the Florida Panhandle, including the following
areas, Central Walton, Coastal Gulf, Holmes, Coastal Bay, Inland
Bay, Inland Gulf, North Walton, South Walton and Washington.

* WHEN...From 11 AM EDT  /10 AM CDT/ this morning through Monday
morning.

* IMPACTS...Excessive runoff may result in flooding of rivers,
creeks, streams, and other low-lying and flood-prone locations.
Flooding may occur in poor drainage and urban areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- Multiple rounds of heavy rainfall are expected Saturday afternoon
through at least early Monday morning. Additional rainfall
amounts of 3 to 6 inches of rain are expected with locally higher
amounts of up to 10 inches possible. This may lead to flash
flooding, especially in urban and poor drainage areas.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
items.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.
